content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email for the IIT Delhi recruitment 2026 is 09 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the positions of Sr Project Assistant (Admin) and Jr Project Assistant (Admin) at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi under this advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these posts is strictly via email. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and send it to the specified email address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Sr Project Assistant and Jr Project Assistant posts at IIT Delhi. Candidates can apply for free.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Sr Project Assistant (Admin)?
faq.answer: The salary for the Sr Project Assistant (Admin) post ranges from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350 per month, plus 30% HRA, depending on the pay scale structure defined in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Jr Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The required qualification for the Jr Project Assistant (Admin) post is a Graduate Degree or a three-year Diploma, along with 8 years of relevant work experience as specified in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection process for the IIT Delhi recruitment involves the short-listing of eligible candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form (Form No. IRD/REC-4) can be downloaded from the official IRD website of IIT Delhi at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec. Ensure you use the correct form as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the positions of Sr Project Assistant (Admin) and Jr Project Assistant (Admin) at IIT Delhi are on a contract basis. Please refer to the official notification for specific contract duration details.

faq.question: Q10. What should be mentioned in the email subject line?
faq.answer: When sending your application via email, you must clearly mention the advertisement number (IITD/IRD/252/2026) and the name of the post applied for in the subject line of your email.
